page = 0

    result = apis.phone.search_text_messages(access_token=phone_token, query="splitwise", page_index=page, page_limit=20)
    if not result:
        break
    messages.extend(result)
    if len(result) < 20:
        break
    page += 1
print(f"Total messages found: {len(messages)}")
for m in messages:
    print(m)
